items.title: Neville: Carrick has got to stop defending the players
items.description: Gary Neville has urged Michael Carrick to stop defending Manchester United players after another troubling performance in their draw at Fulham.

items.description: Real Madrid manager Jose Mourinho prints out screenshots displaying two incidents he believes should have resulted in Atletico Madrid dismissals.

items.description: "Pathetic" Manchester United? Michael Carrick says not, but knows improvement is required to prove his old team-mate Gary Neville wrong.

items.title: Cunha's late strike denies Fulham first league win of season
items.description: Matheus Cunha's deflected strike in the 89th minute rescues a point for Manchester United and denies Fulham their first Premier League win of the season.

items.title: Man City beat Sunderland in eight-goal thriller to go three points clear
items.description: Manchester City beat Sunderland 5-3 in a thrilling Etihad encounter, to go three points clear at the top of the Premier League table.

items.title: Liverpool boss Iraola makes winning return to Bournemouth
items.description: Liverpool manager Andoni Iraola makes a winning return to his former side Bournemouth, with the Reds securing a 1-0 win at the Vitality Stadium courtesy of a second-half goal from Alexander Isak.

items.title: Leeds continue unbeaten start in league with draw against Palace
items.description: Leeds United maintain their unbeaten start to their Premier League campaign thanks to a hard-earned goalless draw at home against Crystal Palace.
